components.name: Status Mark
components.description: Compact menu-bar input-source state with a single readable glyph.
components.html: 听
components.css: .vi-status-mark { display:grid; place-items:center; width:22px; height:16px; box-sizing:border-box; border:1px solid #1f1d1a; border-radius:2px; background:#1f1d1a; color:#f7f6f3; font:600 12px/1 'Songti SC', STSong, serif; } .vi-status-mark[data-state='recording'] { background:#b42318; border-color:#b42318; }

components.name: Candidate Strip
components.description: A cursor-adjacent transient status surface with words instead of a waveform.
components.html: 听正在听本机 · 松开 Fn 写入0:04
components.css: .vi-candidate { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:320px; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid #b42318; border-radius:2px; background:#f7f6f3; color:#22201c; box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(40,45,55,.16); font:400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .vi-candidate strong,.vi-candidate small { display:block; } .vi-candidate small,.vi-candidate time { color:#6f6a63; font-size:11px; } .vi-candidate time { margin-left:auto; font-family:'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Settings Row
components.description: A flat, native-density settings row with a one-pixel separator.
components.css: .vi-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; min-height:32px; padding:9px 0; border-top:1px solid #dedbd4; color:#22201c; font:400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .vi-row:focus-within { outline:2px solid Highlight; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Recovery Action
components.description: A direct text action used for permission recovery, retry, or diagnostics.
components.css: .vi-action { padding:6px 10px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#b42318; font:400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .vi-action:hover { background:rgba(180,35,24,.08); } .vi-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid Highlight; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Voice Input behaves like a quiet capability built into macOS. It stays almost invisible during daily use, becomes explicit only for setup or recovery, and uses the vocabulary of input sources and System Settings instead of standalone AI-product spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Cursor-adjacent text status instead of waveforms

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Recording and success colors remain rare and never carry state alone.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the macOS type scale and reserve Songti SC for the single status glyph.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows explain detached physical layers and never decorate static settings content.

dos: Do use native controls and plain-language state labels.
Do keep the local processing boundary visible.
Do provide keyboard, accessibility, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't copy centered floating pills, continuous waveforms, or writing-assistant overlays.
Don't create a chatbot, document editor, or large dashboard.
Don't use decorative glass, gradients, neon, marketing metrics, or repetitive card grids.
